title: MV YEP CTB - Target doesn't always move to the expected position in turn order

posts.author: KayronDEV
posts.body:
Hi everyone,
I’m using
Yanfly’s Charge Turn Battle CTB
system in RPG Maker MV, and I’ve run into an odd behavior with a notetag. I have a skill that should
delay the target’s next turn
by a fixed amount using this tag <CTB Order: +2>.
Sometimes this works correctly, the target moves back in the turn order as expected.
But other times,
the target barely moves
, or doesn’t move at all. The plugin order is correct , YEP_X_BattleSysCTB is loaded before any other CTB or turn-modifying plugins.
Why doesn’t <CTB Order: +x>
always
push the target exactly “x positions” back in the turn order?
Is there some internal clamping, scaling, or percentage logic that limits how much it can shift?
Is there any way to
force
the target to move to an exact CTB position? Can an addon do this maybe?
